info.title: Resolve JSON API
info.description: Contract for the mobile app and any UI. Mobile needs the 'mobile' tag: POST /chat, GET /api/chat/{session_id} (poll for support replies after a handoff), GET /api/users, POST /feedback. Default dev server: http://<laptop-LAN-IP>:8010.

post.summary: Send one user message to the Level 2 agent
Feedback outside the chat; triage runs in the background
File the bug report as one Jira issue; a failure from Jira comes back as jira_error

409.description: Wrong ticket status for this call

agent_log.title: Agent Log
agent_log.description: Latest agent replies, newest first (all time, at most 20)

team.title: Team
team.description: The team from config.teams whose `handles` fits

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: What breaks, one line an engineer understands

details.title: Details
details.description: Where it breaks, the version and device if given, what the user did, expected and actual. No names or emails.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: high: paying users lose what they paid for or the app is unusable; medium: a feature is broken; low: cosmetic

ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: GET /api/chat/{session_id}: poll this to show a support reply that arrives after a handoff.

jira.description: The person's edits of the bug report, filed with this reply; not part of the stored decision

days_each.title: Days Each
days_each.description: Days of each Level 2 grant, oldest first

flow.title: Flow
flow.description: Flow key from the offline dataset

flow.title: Flow
flow.description: Flow key from the offline dataset, or 'unknown'

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: What changed, e.g. 'top issue changed: Refund request → Charged after trial'

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.description: Why it will not start: 'hourly cap', 'cooling down', 'last auto run failed'

draftable.title: Draftable
draftable.description: Two or more flows: can be an A/B test

caveat.title: Caveat
caveat.description: What the data cannot tell, or the part a paywall cannot fix

variant_source.title: Variant Source
variant_source.description: The variant arm is another existing flow, or an edited copy of the control

variant_flow.title: Variant Flow
variant_flow.description: The existing flow used as the variant arm (variant_source = existing_flow)

ticket_ids.title: Ticket Ids
ticket_ids.description: Tickets the hypothesis was read from

cited_cells.title: Cited Cells
cited_cells.description: The first is the tested cell

what_changed.title: What Changed
what_changed.description: Computed from counts against the replaced report: the test kept or moved

model_calls.title: Model Calls
model_calls.description: Model calls the run took (2 = one corrective retry)

latency_s.title: Latency S
latency_s.description: Wall time of the model calls

auto.title: Auto
auto.description: The hypothesis re-runs on its own after a material change

top.description: Raw top: the category with most tickets and its most common flow

tested.description: The cell the current report tests (its cited_cells[0]), with its ticket count now

previous.description: The report the current one replaced

auto_create.title: Auto Create
auto_create.description: The agent files its bug reports on its own; off = a person's click

max_auto_per_day.title: Max Auto Per Day
max_auto_per_day.description: The most issues the agent files on its own in 24 hours

JiraExport.title: JiraExport
JiraExport.description: What the support person may change before creating the issue. None keeps the agent's value.

connected.title: Connected
connected.description: JIRA_BASE_URL, JIRA_EMAIL and JIRA_API_TOKEN are all set

key.title: Key
key.description: Null in demo mode: no issue was created

project_key.title: Project Key
project_key.description: The Jira project this team works in, e.g. FIT

handles.title: Handles
handles.description: What this team fixes: the agent routes by it

issue_type.title: Issue Type
issue_type.description: The issue type in that project

OpenCounts.title: OpenCounts
OpenCounts.description: True totals of the open_tasks kinds (open_tasks lists at most 20 of each).

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: For the live list: chat = the agent's last tool step, review = the agent's first option; null for triage

OptionEdits.title: OptionEdits
OptionEdits.description: What the support person may change before accepting. Any field left None keeps the option's value.

days.title: Days
days.description: grant_access only: days of the access level

question.title: Question
question.description: ask_user only: the question to the user

t.title: T
t.description: Bucket start, UTC 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ' (a local hour or a local day)

ReplySide.title: ReplySide
ReplySide.description: One column of 'reply by reply': machines (agent messages) or humans (replies sent from Incoming). Shares are 0..1.

customer_user_id.title: Customer User Id
customer_user_id.description: Empty string when the user is not identified

title.title: Title
title.description: What a person reads: the subject they wrote, else from the triage summary, else the handoff reason

top_risk.title: Top Risk
top_risk.description: The risk of the agent's first option

action_kind.title: Action Kind
action_kind.description: The category of action_title; it sets the line's tone on screen

action_title.title: Action Title
action_title.description: The line under the title in Incoming: 'Still generating, please wait' until a triage result or error exists, 'We've generated 3 responses, pick one' while it waits for a person, 'A tough one, your call' when no option is one the agent is sure of, on a closed ticket the person's stored decision ('You've chosen an option'); null while new

action_accent.title: Action Accent
action_accent.description: The part of action_title that names what the person does, drawn in the accent colour

triage_error.title: Triage Error
triage_error.description: Why Level 1 triage failed; the ticket stays new

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: Only with ?q=: the text around the first match

legacy.title: Legacy
legacy.description: True when triage was built from a v1 proposal

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: Decision on accept; {rejected: true, note, reply} on reject

jira.description: The Jira issue filed for this ticket

history.title: History
history.description: Earlier closes of a reopened ticket: {at, from_status, decision, action, note}

customer_user_id.title: Customer User Id
customer_user_id.description: Empty string when the user is not identified

title.title: Title
title.description: What a person reads: the subject they wrote, else from the triage summary, else the handoff reason

top_risk.title: Top Risk
top_risk.description: The risk of the agent's first option

action_kind.title: Action Kind
action_kind.description: The category of action_title; it sets the line's tone on screen

action_title.title: Action Title
action_title.description: The line under the title in Incoming: 'Still generating, please wait' until a triage result or error exists, 'We've generated 3 responses, pick one' while it waits for a person, 'A tough one, your call' when no option is one the agent is sure of, on a closed ticket the person's stored decision ('You've chosen an option'); null while new

action_accent.title: Action Accent
action_accent.description: The part of action_title that names what the person does, drawn in the accent colour

triage_error.title: Triage Error
triage_error.description: Why Level 1 triage failed; the ticket stays new

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: Only with ?q=: the text around the first match

closed_by_people.title: Closed By People
closed_by_people.description: Tickets a person closed in Level 1

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: Other feedback that came in (form, email)

reply.title: Reply
reply.description: Draft reply to the user, ready to send, under 120 words. Empty for no_reply.

risk_reason.title: Risk Reason
risk_reason.description: One line: why this risk level (money, abuse, wrong diagnosis).

emoji.title: Emoji
emoji.description: One emoji, sincere, that says what this answer means for the user (👍 we give something, ❌ we say no or end something, 🙏 we apologise, ❓ we ask, 🧾 we explain, 🔁 restore).

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: How sure you are that this answer is right for this user, 0 to 1, judged for this option on its own.

reply_en.title: Reply En
reply_en.description: Faithful English translation of reply for the support person. Null when user_language is English.

customer_user_id.title: Customer User Id
customer_user_id.description: The Adapty customer user id, or null when not found

lookup.title: Lookup
lookup.description: How the user was identified or why not (e.g. 'id from chat', 'email not in index')

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One sentence: what the user wants

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Facts used, each 'field: value' from the profile or history

root_cause.title: Root Cause
root_cause.description: One sentence hypothesis of why this happened

bug_report.description: For the engineering team, when the cause is a defect in the product; null otherwise

user_language.title: User Language
user_language.description: The language the user writes in, as an English name (Russian, Spanish, Serbian (Latin)); English for English users. Mixed: the language of most of their latest message.

messages_en.title: Messages En
messages_en.description: Faithful English translation of each numbered message [1], [2], ... in order, one entry each. Null when user_language is English.

TriageView.title: TriageView
TriageView.description: A Level 1 ticket as shown by the API: a v1 legacy proposal has a single option.
